review_candidates.title: Infrastructure Engineer III
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Manage and maintain Kubernetes clusters across enclaves (NIPR-Il5/SIPR/JWICS). Troubleshoot cluster and deployment issues alongside other teams. RESPONSIBILTIES Strong knowledge of cloud computing in a DoD context including industry standard tooling and major cloud service providers. Provides requirement decomposition/definition and engineering expertise to assure program DOD requirements are developed and sustained. Performs other related duties as assigned Key Qualifications Clearance: Active
eligibility_evidence: Department of Defense and related national security customers.

Performs other related duties as assigned Key Qualifications Clearance: Active TS/SCI Education and Years of Experience: Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology or Similar Discipline with at least 5 years of relevant experience.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Backed by Falfurrias Management Partners, the platform brings together deep domain expertise across Army, Navy, and Air Force and Space Force programs, digital engineering, systems integration, and specialized manufacturing capabilities. Provides requirement decomposition/definition and engineering expertise to assure program DOD requirements are developed and sustained. Possesses a strong expertise in DOD areas such as command and control, intelligence, acquisition, data handling, space, and cyber, and intelligence data handling. Performs other related duties as assigned Key Qualifications Clearance: Active TS/SCI Education and Years of Experience: Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology or Similar Discipline with at least 5 years of relevant experience.
